properties.project_name: Mission Bay Ferry Landing -- WETA/Port ferry terminal under construction
properties.digitized_from: No Assessor block/lot exists for this Port/WETA ferry facility (confirmed: DataSF's 'Parcels - Active and Retired' Socrata dataset, acdm-wktn, has no PIER-numbered street_name entries near this site). No Port/WETA/SFCTA GIS shapefile or site-plan figure was available, so this is a coarse locational box centered near Agua Vista Park (801 Terry A. Francois Blvd, a real, addressed park immediately next to the project per the Port's own project page), using the real address range in DataSF's official street centerlines for that stretch of Terry A. Francois Blvd. CORRECTED 2026-10-10: the outline is now two shapes traced from the layout plan in the City's own environmental review -- Figure 3 (PDF p. 10) of the Final Mitigated Negative Declaration, San Francisco Planning Case No. 2017-008824ENV, amended 2018-06-18 (https://sfmea.sfplanning.org/Mission%20Bay%20Ferry_Final%20MND_061818.pdf) -- the Ferry Landing (connecting ramp, pier, gangway and float) and the Water Taxi Landing (platform, gangway and float). The plan was placed by overlaying its own aerial backdrop on Esri World Imagery (zoom 20, captured 2025-08-29): its printed structure sizes set the scale (about 0.21 m per plan pixel), no rotation was needed, and the existing Agua Vista Park fishing pier, the shoreline and the roadway match the satellite image. These are the structures as designed in 2018, not as built.
properties.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- the two landings as drawn in the City's 2018 layout plan (Final Mitigated Negative Declaration, Figure 3), placed on satellite imagery by overlay, accurate to a few metres at best. This is the 2018 design, not an as-built survey: imagery captured 2025-08-29 shows no landing built yet, and no later plan was found, so the design or its position may have changed. Each shape joins the landing's pieces (Ferry Landing: connecting ramp and pier, gangway, float; Water Taxi Landing: platform, gangway, float). Lengths measured off the drawing differ from the sizes the document states: the gangways scale to about 70 ft against the stated 85 ft (ferry) and 80 ft (water taxi), and the ferry float to about 128 ft against 135 ft. The shapes follow the drawing. The Ferry Landing's landward end is trimmed to Bayfront Park's boundary, where the drawn corner overlapped it by about 35 m2. Landside improvements, dredge areas and the fender piles are not included.
properties.why_no_real_parcel: Port/WETA ferry facility; not on the Assessor's secured roll (data.sf.gov acdm-wktn has no PIER-numbered parcels near this site).
properties.regulatory_context: A WETA/Port of San Francisco ferry terminal project. Marine demolition of derelict piles (Phase 2a) was reported complete in 2025; ferry-landing and upland construction (Phase 2b) is under way, with completion targeted by the end of 2027. The San Francisco County Transportation Authority approved sales-tax (Prop L) funding toward the project, including a further allocation reported in April 2026.
properties.notes: This is a Port/WETA transit facility, not an OCII Mission Bay South development block -- grouped under the Mission Bay South site here because that is the nearest tracked site and because DataSF's official 'Former San Francisco Redevelopment Agency Project Areas' boundary for Mission Bay South extends north along the Terry A. Francois Blvd shoreline to include this stretch (the boundary contains this location). Recorded as adjacent rather than tracked because it is Port/WETA transit infrastructure, not a Mission Bay OCII development parcel like this site's other tracked records.
